name: @platos-refs/entity-docs-mcp-bridge
description: Reference entity backend that bridges an external MCP server (mcp.platos.dev/mcp by default) into Platos as a connected entity. Lists upstream tools at startup, registers each one through the platools SDK, forwards tool-calls via standard MCP transport. Mirror this pattern for any other MCP you want to use inside Platos until native external-MCP consumption ships.
